subject: general
question: **According to the passage, the ‘acid mantle’ refers to:**

options.text: an acidic skin product with the right pH
a layer over the skin that is balanced by healthy skin in terms of its pH
an acidic cleansing agent with a pH of 5.5
a layer over the skin that keeps the skin pH at 5.5

solution:
The correct answer is: **a layer over the skin that is balanced by healthy skin in terms of its pH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fifth sentence of the second paragraph in the given passage states that- *"Healthy skin quickly rebalances the ‘acid mantle’ – a protective layer over the skin __– and is unaffected in the long term by the cleanser’s pH."*
 
• That means **‘acid mantle’** is a **pH-balanced layer over the skin that is maintained by healthy skin.**

From here we can conclude that option 2 is the right answer.
